page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword "Quod" at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: Dei Ludibrio, & ipsius Ecclesiam direptioni exposuit.

Illustrissimos Principes & Ordines rogabit idem D. Segurius, ut tan-tisper dum paratur generalis Synodus, curationem istam sibi praevertendam suscipiant, quae duplici ratione commodissime absolvi possit. Altera quidem si omnium utriusque professionis Ecclesiarum controversiae ad Synodum dijudicandae referantur, neque cuiquam privatim in aliorum fraudem & praejudicium quicquam interea statuere liceat; altera vero si acerbis illis contentionibus, quibus hactenus & verbis inter se rixati sunt Theologi & scriptis, silentio tandem finis imponatur, & ejusmodi disputationibus explosis Christiana caritas & animorum fraterna conjunctio colatur; quod quidem Serenissimus Rex Navarre ab Ecclesiis Gallicis (a quibus hac de re rogatus est) tam suo quam ipsorum nomine bona fide praestitum irrefragabiliter spondet.

page.notes: The first line of the printed header reads "Reg. Gall. ad Imp. &c." with page number 425. Catchword "Quod" at lower right. The word "irispondet" is printed as "ispondet" with a long-s form; transcribed as printed where legible. Some words are uncertain due to print quality, notably "irrefragabiliter" and "ispondet", marked as read from the scan.
